name: Real Road Racer
storyline:
Five years ago you walked away from the best crew in the business. Now they’ve robbed Vega’s vault, and five cars in five cities each carry a page of his ledger. Catch them all, and take down each driver with three hits before they get away.

The Handoff, New York (Dex)
Hill Rats, Lisbon (Inês)
Neon Wire, Tokyo (Ryo)
Whiteout, Furka Pass (Anselm)
The Boss, Milan (Silas)
Each chase has its own weather, time of day, a story cutscene, and a special ability for the driver you’re chasing: oil slicks, sheep crossing, neon trail, ramming goats and old rivals. Your progress and best times are saved in your browser.
